scope: Consolidated staged presentation and current-spec correction; no model/image mutation or generation
visual_inspection: Viewed cat.png and every embedded stage image without altering them. Captions distinguish source photographs, AI references and actual renders.

findings.observation: P03 same-pose.png already has finer, more fragmented color facets than cat.png; P04 standing carries this forward. This is a qualitative observation, not a calibrated score or proof of a sole cause.
findings.next_test: A shared style rule should be tested on normal-view reference imagery before further per-cat surface editing; evaluate major identity boundaries and facet scale separately.

findings.observation: Current 3500-triangle clay view retains flank ridges. Material repair does not remove these geometry defects.

automation_scope: The stage renderer reads a manifest, validates file paths and image decoding, hashes evidence and updates the workflow section. Stage assignment and quality judgments remain manual.
removed_manual_work: Future stage presentation can be regenerated from manifest without manually assembling markdown links; no upstream cat-generation manual dependency was removed.
generalization_validation: Only this case manifest tested; no claim of unseen-cat generation success.
unpassed: Low Poly Animated Cats animation compatibility
hash_failure_resolution: Scene, GLB and analysis mesh match original verification hashes. Render-report differs only in a proven description correction and its note; reverting those two fields reconstructs the exact historical SHA256. No geometry, camera, numeric or material-report field changed.
